get.description:
Get a collection of `Person` objects.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Person` objects will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `Person` object by ID*.
Only `Person` object will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_person_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Person` object to get

patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Person` object identified by ID*.
Only `Person` object will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_person_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Person` object to modify/update

202.description: Successfully accepted the modification of `Person` object

delete.description:
*Delete a `Person` object by ID*.
Only `Person` object will be deleted that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_person_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Person` object to modify/update
